title: Mending the Red Kite (Fictional Clip)
description: Fictional 40-second clip concept for a test feed. On a windy hillside, a child finds a torn seam in a red diamond kite. An older neighbour shows how to patch the tear with tape and a scrap of nylon, then re-tie the loose bridle line. In the last seconds, the repaired kite lifts and holds steady in the wind. This is an invented scenario, not a real video or observed event.
